name: CardiacLens v9.10.347.200
notes: Fluid push reminders now work directly from the pacing engine's calculated next-drink suggestion, not only from named Plan My Day or Scheduled Events.
Users who only use the fluid pacing setup in Settings (fluid min/max and end time) now get real push reminders with no need to also set up Plan My Day or Scheduled Events for fluid.
If both a named fluid event and a pacing suggestion exist at the same time, whichever is sooner determines the reminder.
label: PacingBasedFluidPush
summary: Push reminders now follow the fluid pacing engine directly, so pacing-only users get real background notifications without setting up any events.
changes: _buildFluidPaceHtml now exposes its computed next-drink time via window._cbPaceNextDrinkMins.
The dashboard render's push sync now compares the named-event due time and the pacing due time, and syncs whichever is sooner, instead of only using named events.
No unrelated CardiacLens behavior was intentionally changed.
testing: Verified new logic in isolation for syntax.
Verified overall bracket balance change matches expected delta from the new code only.
Not yet verified: live push delivery from a pacing-only setup with no Plan My Day or Scheduled Events configured. Test this before relying on it.
